Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. When will a change of accommodation on medical grounds be granted to an allottee? Change of accommodation on medical grounds shall be given only when the allottee has already availed of one change in the same type of accommodation. Requests for change will be entertained his family has developed any disease after the change in accommodation. The request must be supported  
if the allottee or a member of by a medical certificate.
